game_concept: A logic puzzle set in The Kingdom – Archery Yard, the garrison archery yard: the knight must handle shadow scouts while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Rename Rush: Pick valid variable names (no spaces, no leading digits) to unlock doors across the area.
theme: The Kingdom – Archery Yard: the garrison archery yard
core_gameplay_loop: In Archery Yard, repeat each round: Pick valid variable names (no spaces, no leading digits) to unlock doors across the area. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the valid_names value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the wall banner using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The wall banner reached with actions_used <= 15.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the wall banner is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 2 (intro tier): Rename Rush
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rename Rush' (Week 1 slot 11), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Archery Yard'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how valid_names changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow scouts in Archery Yard.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The wall banner reached with actions_used <= 15.
